description: Mistral Leanstral 1.5 119B A6B (Lean 4 code agent, 128-expert MoE, FP8, Apache-2.0) on two Sparks with stock vLLM v0.24.0, Ray, tensor parallel 2, 262144-token context, up to 7 concurrent sequences, text and image input, Mistral tool-call and reasoning parsers, eager mode. Basis: MiaAI-Lab's dual-Spark start.sh (no licence file upstream). Optional EAGLE draft (off by default; upstream reports it unstable). Upstream advises reasoning_effort none for general use and a context of 200k or less; Vonk physical two-Spark acceptance is pending. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 with no explicit KV pool, as in MiaAI-Lab's start.sh at 94d72989 (line 21). The steady per-node peak is 0.85 x 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus 10.4 GB for CUDA context, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers (a speculative draft is profiled inside the utilization budget); the reserve is 8 GB, and admission keeps the platform memory floor free beside the peak.
title: Leanstral 1.5 119B A6B vLLM two Sparks
